title: Support bounded task-ID suffixes in governance validation
businessObjective: Allow governed planning follow-on packets to pass CI without weakening task identity enforcement.
technicalObjective: Recognize one optional bounded task-ID suffix in governance branch extraction while retaining exact packet identity matching and rejection behavior.
assumptions: SUT-AIOS-P1-006-PLAN is a valid existing planning packet whose suffix is currently rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Recognize exactly one optional hyphen plus alphanumeric suffix after a canonical three-digit task ID.
Unsuffixed IDs remain unchanged and malformed, doubled, punctuation, or additional suffix forms remain rejected.
CI binds P1-006-PLAN to its exact existing packet/evidence without substituting P1-006 product evidence.
Machine verification passes and forbidden paths remain untouched.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-GOV-033 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
solEscalationTriggers: Any generic parser admission, identity ambiguity, command admission, or scope expansion.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only parser, policy, task and evidence; restore suffix rejection.
